candidate.educational_objective: Dispose of a used contaminated needle promptly in a compliant sharps container without routine recapping.

options.A: Recap it with two hands before disposal
options.B: Place it immediately or as soon as feasible in an appropriate sharps container without recapping
options.C: Leave it on the tray until the end of the medication pass
options.D: Discard it into regular trash if the needle appears intact

candidate.rationale: OSHA requires contaminated sharps to be discarded immediately or as soon as feasible in closable, puncture-resistant, leakproof, labeled or color-coded sharps containers. Contaminated needles generally must not be recapped.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Contaminated needles generally must not be recapped and contaminated sharps must be discarded immediately/as soon as feasible into compliant sharps containers.
candidate.stem: Immediately after using a contaminated needle, what should the nurse do?
